facts.fact: Adam 回到家发现 Vic 在家：一方面他更常在身边，另一方面这意味着 ghost kitchen（幽灵厨房）的排班正在减少。
facts.anchor: On one hand, Vic was around more. On the other, it meant shifts at the ghost kitchen were drying up.

facts.fact: 这次是 Adam 拉着 Vic 一起进行灵魂行走（spirit walk），过程比他预想的容易。
facts.anchor: This, pulling Vic along on a spirit walk, was easier than he expected.

facts.fact: Adam 明白此刻召唤自己的剑就等于违抗 Silver——这不是他会轻率去做的事。
facts.anchor: To call it now would be to defy Silver, which wasn’t something Adam would do lightly.

facts.fact: 灵界墓地一带的涂鸦写着「No More Royals. No More Rules.」。
facts.anchor: Around it were scribbled the words No More Royals. No More Rules.

facts.fact: Lost Ones 的女孩说 Red Wolf 曾承诺他们每个人一个愿望。
facts.anchor: “He promised us wishes,” she said. “That each of us would get one.”

facts.fact: 一名男子反驳女孩说：Wolf 并没有离开，是 the royals（王室）杀了他。
facts.anchor: “He didn’t go away,” a man said. “The royals killed him.”

facts.fact: 半梦半醒间 Adam 说他的愿望是「救 Ian，让他永远不变成 Wolf」。
facts.anchor: “I’d save Ian, keep him from ever becoming the Wolf. You?”

facts.fact: banshee 已死；Adam 说他担心 Lost Ones 发现他们的「天使」死了会如何反应。
facts.anchor: “I don’t know, but I’m worried about how the Lost Ones are going to react when they find their angel dead.”
